move: banner springs down onto a 3D-tilting phone, dims the home screen, retracts
how: A phone mockup under a blue radial glow rotates slowly in 3D (rotationY -14 to 10, rotationX 4 to -3, sine.inOut across the whole 3s, perspective 1600px). At 10% a frosted banner drops from y -130, scale .92 to rest with elastic.out(1,.7) over 0.75s, the Dynamic Island squeezes scaleX 1.2 / scaleY 1.1 yoyo just before, and the app grid and dock dim to brightness .85 via filter. At 77% the banner retracts up with power3.in over 0.4s and the screen brightens again.
adapt: Change the app name, icon gradient, message and wallpaper, and the home-screen icon colours; keep the elastic.out(1,.7) drop and the 0.4s power3.in retract, which is the iOS feel.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the phone and banner from shot; animate returns the timeline with the phone tilt spanning D, banner in at 0.1D and out at 0.77D. Needs perspective on el; uses filter brightness and backdrop-filter, both port as is.
caveats: backdrop-filter blur on the banner and dock
the phone tilt ends at a different angle than it starts, so the loop has a small jump
